headline: Apindo Welcomes World Bank Projection of Indonesia's Economy Growing 5.2 Percent
summary: The Indonesian Employers' Association (Apindo) welcomed the World Bank's projection that Indonesia's economy will grow 5.2% in the period cited. Apindo's chairman Shinta W Kamdani commented on the forecast.
why: World Bank growth forecasts influence investor expectations for Indonesia's economy, bond yields and the rupiah.
